read.thesis: Power margin 21.4% on first better-priced gas shipments, gas equipment pricing up ~50% for FY26 orders, and 130 GW under contract target; $9bn Trench buy adds vertical integration in high-voltage grid parts.

capex.quote: Our 2026 guidance includes a more than 30% year-over-year combined increase in R&D and CapEx as we accelerate our work to support innovation and growth.

triggers.label: Gas equipment pricing ~50% higher FY26
triggers.quote: Full year '26 gas orders pricing per KW will be approximately 50% higher than full year '25 orders.

triggers.label: Power EBITDA margin 21.4%, +830bp
triggers.quote: EBITDA margins expanded 830 basis points to 21.4%, mainly driven by favorable price and higher volume

triggers.label: Gas GW under contract 116 → 122
triggers.quote: grow our total gigawatts under contract from 116 to 122 gigawatts sequentially

triggers.label: FY26 FCF raised to $16-17bn
triggers.quote: we also anticipate our free cash flow to be in the range of $16 billion to $17 billion.

triggers.label: Q3 orders $29.3bn, +96% YoY
triggers.quote: we booked orders of $29.3 billion, a 96% increase year-over-year

guidance.quote: we now expect revenue to be in the range of $46.5 billion to $47.5 billion
adjusted EBITDA margin to be in the range of 13.5% to 14.5%
we also anticipate our free cash flow to be in the range of $16 billion to $17 billion.
we're raising our organic revenue growth expectations from 18% to 20% to 19% to 21%
we're also raising our Power EBITDA margin range by 2 points from 17% to 19% to 19% to 21%
we continue to expect revenue at Electrification to be between $14.5 billion to $15 billion.
We now expect EBITDA losses to be between $400 million and $500 million for the year.
We continue to expect full year 2026 corporate costs to be between $450 million and $500 million
we now expect at least 130 gigawatts under contract by the end of '26
we expect to realize approximately $50 million to $100 million of annualized cost synergies by 2030
a doubling of our stock buyback program from $10 billion to $20 billion

prior_guidance_check.quote: we're raising our GE Vernova financial guidance
we now anticipate organic revenue to be down mid-single digits, better than our previous expectation of down low double digits
We continue to expect full year 2026 corporate costs to be between $450 million and $500 million

red_flags.label: Wind offshore execution risk
red_flags.quote: we've got one more year to go in the offshore execution in the North Sea

red_flags.label: Wind US orders unclear
red_flags.quote: It remains difficult to call an inflection point in U.S. orders as customers still face permitting delays and tariff uncertainty.

evasions.quote: we owe you when we get to our next Capital Markets Day that we'll set that date at the January earnings call
